verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says what happens when a plan's monthly credit quota is exceeded: no overage pricing, no hard-cutoff behavior, and no over-quota error code are documented. The real-time Usage API (docs-29) and the note that failed auto-mode requests cost nothing (docs-18) are adjacent credit-visibility features. Neither answers the overage-versus-cutoff question.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether exceeding my plan's monthly credit or request quota triggers overage charges or a hard cutoff
